capabilities: Set language rules for files, folders or the vault
Highlight inline code, tables and code blocks with 10 offline themes
Recognize unmarked exercise code in prose
Render Markdown text blocks as headings, lists and tables
Add rule actions to Notebook Navigator context menus
disambiguation: Not a color-palette or theme editor; it applies code-highlighting themes and language rules to code in notes.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.0 or later; mobile behavior untested. Syntax highlighting only, with no code execution or language-server semantic coloring.
problem: Obsidian highlights code only from per-block language labels and the app theme, with no default language per file or folder and no separate code theme.
summary: Code highlighter that applies scoped language rules and independent themes to inline code, tables and code blocks.
